verses.en: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.sm: Noa ma ona atalii, ma ua faapea atu ia te i latou, la owon fanafanau, ma ia uluola, ma ia tumu le lalolagi ia te outou.

verses.en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
verses.sm: O le mata'u ja te outou ma le fefe ia te outou e 00 i manu vaefa uma o le lalolagi, ma manu felelei uma, ma mea uma e feoai i le eleele, atoa ma ia uma o le sami; ua tuuina atu ia i o outou lima.

verses.en: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
verses.sm: O mea ola uma e feoai, e a outou ia e fai ma mea e ‘ai; ua ou foaiina atu ma outou o mea uma, e pei o laau afu e tupu lauolaola.

verses.en: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.sm: A 0 le aano o manu o i ai le ola, o lona toto foi lea, aua tou te aai ai.

verses.en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
verses.sm: § E moni lava, ou te taui atu lo outou toto o lo outou ola; ou te tauiatua i manu uma; o le tagata foi, ou te taui atu le ola o le tagata i le tagata lona uso.

verses.en: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
verses.sm: O se na te faamaligiina le toto o le tagata, e faamaligiina lona lava toto e le tagata; aua o le faatusa o le Atua na fai ai e ia le tagata.

verses.en: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
verses.sm: O outou foi, ia outou fanafanau, ma ia outou uluola; ia outou tuputupulaiina i le lalolagi, ma ia outou uluola ai.

verses.en: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi le Atua ia Noa, ma ona atalii faatasi ma ia, o loo faapea atu,

verses.en: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.sm: Faauta foi, o a‘u, ou te faatumauina la‘u feagaiga ma outou, ma a outou fanau pe a mavae outou;

verses.en: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
verses.sm: atoa foi ma mea ola uma o ia te outou, o manu felelei, o manu vaefa fanua, ma manu O le vao uma o ja te outou, O mea uma ua ulufafo i le vaa e oo i manu uma o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.sm: Ou te faatumauina lava laʻu feagaiga ma outou; e le toe faaumatia lava mea ola uma i le vai o se lolo; e leai foi se toe lolo e faaumatia ai le lalolagi.

verses.en: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi le Atua, O le faailoga lenei o le feagaiga ou te faia ma outou, atoa ma mea ola uma O ia te outou, e autupulaga lava;

verses.en: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.sm: ua ou tuuina laʻu nuanua i le ao, e fai ma faailoga o le feagaiga a le lalolagi ma aʻu.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
verses.sm: A ou faamalumaluina ifo le lalolagi i se ao, ma ua iloa le nuanua i le ao;

verses.en: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.sm: ona ou manatua lea o laʻu feagaiga ua ou osia ma outou, ma mea ola eseese uma lava; e le toe avea le vai ma lolo e faaumatia ai mea ola I5 uma.

verses.en: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.sm: E i ai foi le nuanua i le ao, ou te vaai foi i ai, e manatua ai le feagaiga e faavavau ua osia e au o le Atua ma mea ola eseese uma lava o i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu le Atua ia Noa, O le faailoga lenei o le feagaiga ua ou faatumauina e aʻu ma mea ola uma o i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.sm: O atalii foi nei o Noa e na ulufafo i le vaa, o Semu, ma Hamo, ma lafeta; o Hamo foi o le tama ia o Kanana.

verses.en: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
verses.sm: O atalii nei e toatolu o Noa; o i latou foi na aina solo ai le lalolagi uma.

verses.en: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
verses.sm: Ona amata lea e Noa ona galue i le eleele, ua ia fai foi le tovine.

verses.en: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.sm: Ua inu foi e ia le uaina, ma ua ona ai; ua le lavalava foi o ia i lona fale ie.

verses.en: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.sm: Ona iloa atu lea e Hamo le tama o Kanana le le lavalavá o lona tamā, i le ua ta‘uina atu e ia i ona uso e toalua i fafo.

verses.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
verses.sm: Ona fetagofi lea o Semu ma lafeta i le ofu, ma faaee ai i o la tau‘au, ma la savavali tuumuli i tua, ma ufiufi ai le le lavalavá o lo la tama; ua faasaga ese foi O laua mata, ua le iloa atu foi e i laua le le lavalavá o lo la tama.

verses.en: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
verses.sm: Ua ala Noa i lana uaina, ua iloa foi e ia le mea ua faia ia te ia e lona atalii aupito itiiti;

verses.en: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.sm: ona fai ane lea o ia, E malaia Kanana; e matuā fai o ia ma pologa i ona uso.

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.sm: Ua fai ane foi o ia, Ua faafetaia le ALII le Atua o Semu; e fai foi Kanana mona pologa.

verses.en: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.sm: E faalauteleina Iafeta e le Atua, e mau foi o ia i fale ie o Semu; e fai foi Kanana mona pologa.

verses.en: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.sm: Na ola foi Noa talu mai le lolo i tausaga e tolu selau me le limagafulu.

verses.en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.sm: O aso uma foi o Noa e iva selau ma le limagafulu, o ona tausaga ia; ona oti ai lea.
